data.eligibility_information:
Educational Qualification
MS or PhD in one of the following (or closely related fields):
Data Science / Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence
Statistics / Mathematics
Computer Science / Engineering
Bioinformatics / Biosciences / Biotechnology
Candidates with a clinical degree (MBBS, MD, or equivalent) combined with strong analytical or technical experience are also encouraged to apply
Experience
0–3 years of relevant experience (including research, internships, or industry work)
Fresh MS/PhD graduates with strong project or research experience are welcome
Prior experience in healthcare, life sciences, or real-world data (RWD) is a plus but not mandatory
data.additional_information:
About Us
NeuroDiscovery AI is a neurology-focused company working at the intersection of clinical research and patient care. We leverage one of the world’s largest real-world neurology datasets to generate insights that directly impact millions of patients living with complex neurological conditions.
We partner with leading neurology provider practices across the United States to:
Accelerate clinical trial identification and recruitment
Generate high-quality real-world evidence (RWE)
Translate cutting-edge scientific advances into improved patient outcomes
Our work sits at a unique interface of AI, healthcare, and translational research—where rigorous science meets real-world impact.
Role Overview
We are looking for highly motivated MS and PhD graduates to join our AI, Engineering, and Research teams.
This is a capability-first hiring program—not tied to a predefined role. Based on your strengths, interests, and performance during the selection process, you will be placed into the team where you can create the most impact.
You will work on challenging, real-world problems aimed at advancing our understanding, diagnosis, and treatment of neurological disorders.
What We Look For (Core Skill Set)
Educational Background
MS or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, Statistics, Biosciences, Biotechnology, or a related field
Equivalent experience combined with a clinical degree will also be considered
Technical Foundations
Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Python and/or SQL
Ability to work with complex datasets: querying, joining, and transforming data
Experience with high-performance computing or cloud environments (preferred)
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
Strong analytical thinking with attention to detail, especially in contexts involving data accuracy and patient safety
Ability to break down complex problems into structured, scalable solutions
Communication & Collaboration
Ability to translate technical concepts for clinical audiences and clinical context for technical teams
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work independently while collaborating across cross-functional teams
Research Mindset
Intellectual curiosity and a desire to solve impactful, real-world problems
Prior research experience and/or publications (preferred)
Preferred Skills by Team
AI / Machine Learning / Data Science
Build ML models, LLM workflows, and multimodal AI systems that simulate clinical reasoning
Develop AI-driven solutions for prediction, cohort discovery, and clinical decision support in neurology
Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), NLP, transformers, and LLMs
Familiarity with multimodal data (EHR + imaging + clinical text)
Experience in model evaluation, interpretability, and deployment in healthcare settings
Engineering (Data & Platform)
Build and manage pipelines for longitudinal EHR, claims, and imaging data
Ensure data quality, standardization, interoperability, and readiness for AI and research use
Develop clinician-facing applications, dashboards, and AI copilots
Design scalable, secure systems aligned with real-world clinical workflows
Preferred Technical Skills:
Distributed systems, backend development, and API design
Cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and data engineering tools
Experience with healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7, OMOP)
Data pipeline orchestration (Airflow, Spark, etc.)
Research / Clinical Informatics
Design and evaluate studies using structured datasets to generate clinically credible evidence
Validate hypotheses, outcomes, and product insights using real-world data
Analyze treatment patterns, disease progression, and outcomes at scale
Generate insights beyond controlled trials for providers and pharma
Clinical Research Applications:
Accelerate clinical trials through data-driven patient identification and site selection
Improve recruitment efficiency and trial feasibility using real-world signals
Preferred Skills:
Familiarity with neurological diseases (Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, epilepsy, etc.)
Experience with causal inference and observational study design
Experience working with large-scale real-world datasets
Knowledge of healthcare ontologies: ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, LOINC, SNOMED
Experience with EHR systems (eClinicalWorks, AthenaOne, etc.)
Data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
data.additional_details:
Why Join NeuroDiscovery AI?
Work on real-world problems that directly impact patient lives
Be part of a team at the intersection of AI, medicine, and research
Shape your role based on your strengths and interests
Collaborate with experts across disciplines
Contribute to building the future of data-driven neurology care
Note to Candidates
This is a flexible hiring program designed to identify high-potential individuals and match them to roles where they can thrive.
If you are excited about solving meaningful problems at the intersection of technology and healthcare, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every listed criterion.
